crossRefs.note: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the…
For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three…
He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign…
For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be…
With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a…
For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred…
Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them…
They began to beg him to depart from their region.
As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

people.name: Jonah
people.line: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh

translations.web: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them, and departed.
translations.bsb: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Then He left them and went away.
translations.kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
translations.asv: An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of Jonah. And he left them, and departed.
